# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

<!-- cap-evolve:framework-improvements-append-below -->

## From iteration cand_0001 (tau2-airline)
- Some scored tasks are UNWINNABLE from the edit space. In tau2-airline tasks 37 & 40 the recorded episode terminates on the USER's confirmation turn (message ends with `###STOP###`/`###TRANSFER###`), so the agent never gets a turn to fire the write it was about to confirm — the final DB can never match gold no matter how the policy/tools are edited, unless you loosen the global confirmation rule (which regresses the passing confirm-then-act tasks). Suggestion: either (a) exclude such terminal-turn tasks from the pass/fail denominator, or (b) let the harness grant the agent one trailing turn after a terminal user confirmation so confirmed writes can execute. As-is, these tasks silently cap the achievable score and push optimizers toward risky global-rule loosening.
- The seed/brief text described the capability as an "EMPTY SEED", but the artifacts (policy.md, tools.py) were fully populated. Recommend the brief reflect the actual seed state so the optimizer doesn't waste a pass verifying whether files exist.
- A pointer to the tau2 venv python (the only interpreter with `tau2`+`loguru` importable) and to `tasks.json` as the gold source would save each iteration the rediscovery — the default `python3` fails with ModuleNotFoundError, which reads like a broken environment.
